description: If 'True', disables Bluetooth entirely on the device. If 'False', Intune doesn't change or update this setting. By default, the OS might allow Bluetooth to be used. Available for fully managed, dedicated, and corporate-owned work profile devices. In comparison, Bluetooth configuration disables the user from making changes to the Bluetooth toggle. As a result, it might be either 'On' or 'Off' depending on the state of Bluetooth prior to applying a policy with Bluetooth configuration enabled.
